scope: Merged Noemorph catalog registered by data/catalog.json; this is a coverage audit, not a claim of exhaustiveness or a theory-synthesis product.

catalog.full_profile_definition: claim_scope, boundary_note, evidence_profile, and open_questions are all populated

methodology.identity_screen: Normalized names, aliases, and structured record text were searched. A not-found result is a proposal for curator identity resolution, not proof of absence from the literature.
methodology.era: Formation-start heuristic: earliest explicit four-digit year or ordinal-century onset in the era field; BCE is separated. Broad spans are assigned to their start. This is not publication-year output.
methodology.geography: No normalized geography field exists. Counts are a conservative, mutually exclusive intellectual-provenance coding of the 112 Historical tradition records only; they are not participant location, author nationality, or source language.
methodology.evidence: No normalized evidence-level field exists. Citation verification, source authority, profile completeness, and pending-review state are reported as proxies and must not be read as effect strength or theory support.
methodology.research_methods: No normalized method field exists. Counts are non-exclusive, recursive keyword signals across record and citation values; a hit can describe context rather than a method actually used by a cited study.
methodology.target_families: Non-exclusive keyword signals in structured name/domain/tradition/keyword fields; useful for triage, not an ontology or recall estimate.
methodology.external_sources: Authoritative or primary sources are attached only where they support a proposed gap or boundary. No source was treated as evidence that the catalog is exhaustive.
methodology.synthesis_gate: Do not infer novel theory-to-theory relationships from these counts. Normalize identities and fields, complete core profiles, then require human review of any semantic candidate before promotion.

ranked_top_15.action: Disaggregate umbrella predictive-processing claims from the specific hybrid architecture; record precision weighting, hierarchy, content/level target, and falsifiable predictions.

ranked_top_15.action: Complete integration/differentiation, reentrant dynamics, temporal-core, and evidence-boundary fields; distinguish it from Neural Darwinism and IIT.

ranked_top_15.action: Treat these as constructs/distinctions, not causal theories; add origin, operational use, contested interpretations, counterexamples, and claim-level sources.
ranked_top_15.acceptance: Each record exposes a clear construct-versus-theory boundary and does not generate causal edges by type confusion.

ranked_top_15.action: Add bounded architecture-of-mind records with modules, learning mechanisms, implementation evidence, scope, and explicit non-equivalence to phenomenal-consciousness theories.

ranked_top_15.action: Create per-taxon dossiers covering neural architecture, behavior, analgesia/anesthesia, motivational trade-offs, metacognition, alternative explanations, and confidence.
ranked_top_15.acceptance: No conscious/not-conscious verdict is generated from a single marker; every conclusion is dimensional and uncertainty-coded.

ranked_top_15.action: Add measure/method records with validation population, target construct, reliability, confounders, variants, and links to—not identity with—theories.
ranked_top_15.acceptance: Measures and methods cannot appear as theory nodes and variants inherit from a parent measure family.

ranked_top_15.action: Separate research programs, taxonomies, indicators, implementation evidence, behavioral claims, and ethical precaution into typed records.
ranked_top_15.acceptance: No theory-derived indicator or simulation result is promoted to a consciousness verdict; implementation and welfare claims have independent sources.

ranked_top_15.action: Commission source-positioned dossiers and add geography, language, translator, community, genre, and interpretive-provenance fields.
ranked_top_15.acceptance: Coverage is documented through primary/community scholarship where available and avoids one-row decontextualized tradition summaries.
